args.title: Fix timezone handling for weekly summary delivery
args.body:
File: src/notifications/rollup.ts

Adjust the logic in isRollupDue to handle time zones with non-whole hour offsets correctly, ensuring that the rollup emails are sent exactly at 08:00 in each user's local timezone.

file: src/notifications/rollup.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The rollup logic currently does not account for time zones with non-whole hour offsets correctly, causing the weekly summary to be sent at incorrect times in certain regions. The logic in `isRollupDue` should be adjusted to ensure precise 08:00 delivery for all time zones.
